summary: Complete reels admin system implemented following project patterns, but contains duplicate navigation entries and route mounts that need cleanup, plus security gaps in URL validation and frontend access control
findings: Duplicate navigation entries — Admin sidebar contains three identical 'Reels' entries that clutter the interface. Remove duplicates from admin-shell.tsx.
Duplicate route mounting — Backend app.js mounts the reels router twice at the same path, which could cause routing conflicts. Remove the duplicate mount statement.
Missing URL validation — VideoUrl and thumbnailUrl fields accept any URL without validation for allowed domains or file types, potentially allowing malicious content. Add domain/format validation.
Frontend access control gap — Admin reels page relies only on navigation visibility for access control, but the page itself has no role-based protection. Add role check or server-side authentication.
